pages.title: Dock two · 1/3
paragraphs: It is ten forty on a windy morning in Seattle. Seagulls cry above the gray water. Jo stands at the harbor with a small backpack. She wants to visit an island for the day. A man in a blue cap checks tickets near the dock. She walks up to him.
“Excuse me, when does the ferry leave?” says Jo. “The next one leaves at eleven fifteen.” says Cap. “Is it from this dock?” says Jo.
